title: 1 million dollarlik aksiya evaziga nimani ko'rsatishgan?
hook: Yirik korporatsiya ixtirosini yosh kompaniyaga ko'rsatdi.

scenes.text: 1979 yilda yirik korporatsiya bir yosh kompaniyaning 1 million dollarlik aksiyalarini sotib oldi.
Evaziga yosh kompaniya xodimlari korporatsiya laboratoriyasidagi tajribaviy kompyuterni ko'rishdi.

description:
1979 yilda Xerox Apple'ning 1 million dollarlik aksiyalarini sotib oldi, evaziga Stiv Jobs va Apple muhandislari Xerox PARC laboratoriyasida oynali interfeys va sichqonchali kompyuterni ko'rishdi. Apple bu g'oyani 1984 yilda Macintosh bilan ommabop qildi, Xerox'ning o'z kompyuteri esa qimmat bo'lib, kam sotildi.

Bu saboq sizga kerakmi? Izohda bitta so'z bilan yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-09: TRUE with small softenings. Xerox's venture arm (Xerox Development Corporation) invested about $1 million in Apple for the right to buy 100,000 pre-IPO shares (price quoted as $10 or $10.50 a share), and Apple's team saw the PARC Alto/Smalltalk/graphical interface demo in early December 1979. Sources: Raskin Center, 'The Xerox PARC visit: what Apple actually saw', https://www.raskincenter.org/mac/xerox-parc/ ; Living Computers Museum, 'What really happened, Steve Jobs at Xerox PARC 79', https://www.livingcomputers.org/Blog/What-Really-Happened-Steve-Jobs-@-Xerox-PARC-79.aspx ; Fortune, Larry Tesler on the visit (Tesler says Xerox approached Apple), https://fortune.com/2014/08/24/raw-footage-larry-tesler-on-steve-jobs-visit-to-xerox-parc/ ; Gladwell, 'Creation Myth', The New Yorker (2011), https://www.newyorker.com/magazine/2011/05/16/creation-myth (could not be opened in this session). Macintosh introduced 22 Jan 1984 at about $2,500 (Smithsonian NMAH); Xerox Star launched 1981 at about $16,595, sold roughly 25,000 units, commercially unsuccessful (Westport Tech Museum, https://www.westporttechmuseum.com/blogs/techtastic/today-in-computer-history-april-27th-1981-xerox-released-the-xerox-star-personal-computer). Edits: 'yangi kompyuter' to 'tajribaviy kompyuter' (the Alto dated from 1973, was never sold as a product); 'ommaga olib chiqdi' to 'ommabop qildi' (Apple's Lisa of 1983 was its first GUI computer, the Mac made it mass-market). Note: the mouse itself was invented earlier by Douglas Engelbart's team at SRI; the script does not claim Xerox invented it.
